name: Apollo BP-15
about: Apollo BP-15 (1964-057A), a crewed vehicle (Apollo BPS), launched 1964 Sep 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (AR).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1964 Sep 20), held fixed
